pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular, multi-sided polygonal regions with soft-to-medium pixel gradients at the edges. Patches on the central flank are larger in spatial area, transitioning to smaller, more condensed geometries toward the dorsal ridge and lower neck.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored interstitial pathways. Junction nodes primarily feature three-way intersections. Thickness is non-uniform, with pathways narrowing significantly between smaller dorsal patches and widening into broader channels on the mid-to-lower flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A continuous 1D geometric contour with low-amplitude, high-frequency serrations representing the mane. The silhouette exhibits a fine, brush-like texture against the background.

other_distinctive_markers: Visible deep skin folds and textural wrinkling located at the ventral-lateral junction near the forelimb.
